data.name: label7.Text
data.value: Tax Symbol presents a product which is taxable, and Non-Tax Symbol presents a product not taxable. On the diagram, Tax-Symbol is presented with a T while for Non-Tax Symbol there is nothing so leave it blank.If the template has no symbols leave it blank completely Copy and paste the Tax Symbol & Non Tax Symbol on the appropiate box

data.name: label26.Text
data.value: To get started open your receipt template using Notepad or any other application that opens text files. This is the receipt template you will be using to train the interface. You are advised to read the scripts highlighted first as you configure the RevMax Interface

data.name: label32.Text
data.value:
Take a look at Diagram 1,The Product "Red Oxide" is on top and then quantity,price and Amount are on different lines hence MultiLine
On The second Diagram they are all on the same line hence SingleLine.
Select SingleLine or MultiLine and click Next

data.name: label22.Text
data.value: Select the Indexes. In this case for the Product "Paper Scrim Rhino", Index for Amount is 1 the Index for Unit Price is 2 and the Index for Product Quantity is 3. You do for the first product only and click Next

data.name: label14.Text
data.value: Copy the Total Amount,TAX and Invoice Number. The TAX is Highlighted as shown on the diagram. Include colons if available and paste them into the appropiate boxes. Paste them in appropiate boxes.

data.name: label10.Text
data.value: Copy the Product StartLine. On the receipt the starline is "Amount" and the endline is "Subtotal".Include two columns for Product StarLine as shown on diagram for starline. Paste them in appropiate boxes
